author: Laura Shary
text: The Technician came out to look at our drainage issue in the backyard.  He was very informative and helpful.  Gave us advice on how how to resolve the problem without incurring unnecessary expenses. We learned alot and he also gave us advice on our drainage pipe from the roof.  Great guy and very pleasant.

author: Elizabeth Heinbach
text: Patrick with Mainline Inspection Services is extremely thorough and knowledgeable. He does a great job with sewer inspections and takes the time to clearly explain his findings and recommendations. I really appreciate his attention to detail and professionalism throughout the process. Highly recommend!

author: Jon Bowling
text: Patrick with Mainline has been a fabulous resource for my team and our clients. His detail is greater than any other inspector I"ve employed through the 24+ years I've been in real estate. He leaves his clients with a 100% clear understanding of the homes waste line system and leaves no doubt in the buyer's eyes as to what they are getting. Don't buy a home without having Mainline Inspection Services inspect the waste lines!

author: Erika Turnbull
text: I am a realtor licensed in Cincinnati/NKY, used Patrick for a office/condo sewer line inspection, he was extremely responsive and willing to go the extra mile. Immediately sent over the report to inform my clients and I of what he had found at the property. My team has used Mainline many times.

author: MW
text: Patrick was great. He took his time and explained everything thoroughly to make sure I had an understanding of how the drainage system was working as he performed the scope. I would definitely use Patrick again and recommend him to anyone needed the plumbing system inspected.
